description: This file defines the PersistentStreamProducer class in the Orleans.Streaming.PersistentStreams namespace. It implements the IInternalAsyncBatchObserver<T> interface and manages message queuing for persistent streams, including methods for sending messages, batching, and handling stream lifecycle events.
